description:
This is Build What Moves India, where 10 teams were selected from 13,694 applications to build solutions for real problems around public services in India.

The teams built everything from an AI-powered cybercrime reporting system and a blood donor matching platform to tools for tracking government spending, verifying land records, applying for visas, filing business forms, and navigating government websites.

Each team gets 10 minutes to pitch their idea, followed by questions from the judges. The judges then have to decide which projects are actually useful, practical, impactful, and possible to implement quickly.

Watch the entire video to find out who actually won and why. But more importantly, you’d also learn why the others didn’t win and what you can learn from it.
